caseName: Anderson v. General American Life Insurance
caseNameFull: Anderson, Receiver v. General American Life Insurance Co.
attorneys: Messrs. Frank E. Wood, Robert S. Marx, and Harry Kasfir for petitioner., Messrs. Wm. Marshall Bullitt, Leo T. Wolford, and Thomas W. Bullitt for respondent., Mr. John F. Anderson filed a brief on behalf of the Comptroller of the Currency, as amicus curiae, in support of the petition.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit denied.
